issues.description: url = ""  # CI fills this — explicitly listed as forbidden template placeholder in code_style rule 5. The url attribute is empty with a comment indicating it should be filled by CI, which is flagged as unfinished work.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the url attribute to the recipe repository URL (e.g., the cnb.cool archive URL) or remove the comment. If CI truly fills it, remove the placeholder comment to avoid flagging.

issues.description: notes.md 编译环境 section says '状态: published' while manifest.yaml status is 'built' and notes.md bottom says '最终状态: built'. The 'published' is a leftover from before the fix and creates inconsistency with the authoritative manifest.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change '状态: published' to '状态: built' in the 编译环境 section to match manifest.yaml and the final status line.

issues.description: README.md says '8.2.6 (published)' but manifest.yaml status is 'built' (no conan upload performed). This is inconsistent with the authoritative manifest and could mislead users into thinking the package was uploaded to the registry.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change '8.2.6 (published)' to '8.2.6 (built)' to match manifest.yaml status.

issues.description: patch_generation section contains hardcoded local paths: source_orig_dir=/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/bdw-gc-8.2.6.orig and source_work_dir=/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/bdw-gc-8.2.6.work. These are machine-specific paths that are not portable and not meaningful on other systems.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace with relative paths or remove the source_orig_dir/source_work_dir fields, keeping only the hashes and method. Alternatively use generic placeholders like '<build_dir>/bdw-gc-8.2.6.orig'.

issues.description: test_package/conanfile.py test() method contains commented-out alternative code: '# Alternatively, run the binary directly: ...'. While informational, this is dead code that should not be in a merged recipe.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the commented-out alternative code block from the test() method.

issues.description: patch_description values (e.g., 'Add HarmonyOS platform detection to config.guess') do not follow the code_style example format which includes a sequence number prefix (e.g., '0001 build aux config.guess'). The descriptions are descriptive but lack the numbered prefix.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider prefixing patch descriptions with the 4-digit sequence number, e.g., '0001 Add HarmonyOS platform detection to config.guess'.

issues.description: upstream_tests list contains only 8 of the 16 upstream tests from 'make check' (as documented in test-report.md). Missing: test_atomic_ops, threadleaktest, threadkey_test, subthreadcreate_test, initsecondarythread_test, disclaim_test, disclaim_bench, disclaim_weakmap_test. assertion_count says 16 which is correct but the list is incomplete.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add the 8 missing upstream test entries to the upstream_tests list to match the 16 tests reported in test-report.md.

summary: Re-audit of bdw-gc 8.2.6 Conan recipe after fixes. All three previously identified P0 issues have been correctly fixed: (1) config.sub patch is now well-formed with no duplicate lines and correct basic_os=linux-ohos; (2) manifest.yaml status changed from 'published' to 'built'; (3) conandata.yml URL is now a single string instead of a mirror list. No new P0 or P1 issues found. Deception detection checks all pass: test_package/test.c calls real GC API (GC_INIT, GC_MALLOC, GC_gcollect — not just printf); sha256 is valid 64-char hex (not forged); no empty #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs (patches 0004/0005 have substantive platform adaptation logic disabling pthread_cancel/pthread_setcancelstate on OHOS); no pre-compiled binaries. Recipe correctness checks pass: library name is 'gc' (correct), system_libs declares ['pthread', 'dl'], CONFIG_SHELL hardcoded path is acceptable on OHOS per zlib pattern, Conan 2.x API used correctly, official GitHub release URL. Four P2 warnings found: url='' placeholder in conanfile.py, inconsistent 'published' status in notes.md and README.md (leftover from pre-fix), and hardcoded local paths in manifest.yaml patch_generation metadata. Three P3 suggestions for dead code, patch_description format, and incomplete MANIFEST.yml upstream test listing. Verdict: PASS — no blocking issues.
